Job Role: Senior Manager - Research




Location: Noida




Department: Research




About Daloopa:

Headquartered in New York, with a growing team in India (Noida), Daloopa is 
the leading provider of AI-powered fundamental data for institutional 
investors. Its proprietary platform sources, structures, and distributes the 
most complete and accurate historical financial dataset—covering nearly 4,700 
public companies globally with more than 10 times the datapoints per company 
compared to other providers. Built for speed, auditability, and integration 
with AI tools, Daloopa helps hedge funds, private equity firms, mutual funds, 
corporates, and investment banks accelerate model- building and research 
workflows. The company recently secured $13M strategic investment to expand its 
AI-ready financial data platform.




At Daloopa, we are driven by our values: Obsess over the customer, Raise the 
bar, be intensely proactive, and No BS. Joining us means being part of a 
culture that challenges you to think deeper, move faster, and make an impact 
every day




Role Overview:

We're hiring a Senior Manager to lead one of our sector research teams within 
the Financial Data C Delivery business unit. The team you'd be running has 20+ 
analysts and the work spans the full earnings cycle — extraction, structuring, 
QA and delivery.




This isn't a role where you inherit a finished machine. We're still building 
a lot of the infrastructure — workflows, automation, team structure — and we 
need someone who's done this before and has views on how it should be done. 
You'll have real authority to make changes and you'll be expected to use it.




You would report into senior leadership and work closely with our product and 
technology teams. The client-facing implications of your team's output are 
direct, so there's no insulation from the consequences of quality issues — 
which also means you'll see the impact of getting things right.




Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership:


 *  Manage a 20+ analyst team covering a specific sector on a day-to-day basis
 *  Run structured performance reviews and build clear career paths for 
junior, mid, and senior analysts
 *  Lead hiring and onboarding, from resume review through the first 90 days 
of a new hire.
 *  Shape the culture of the research function, including feedback, error 
handling, and standards of excellence.


Research Quality & Output:


 *  Own the accuracy and completeness of all team outputs across earnings 
seasons, corporate filings, and ongoing coverage
 *  Set and reinforce quality standards, ensuring analysts understand both 
expectations and their importance in a capital markets context.
 *  Track earnings calendars, coverage gaps, and bandwidth to ensure the team 
is well- positioned ahead of peak periods.


Process & Automation:


 *  Review and refine SOPs where they become inefficient, driving improvements 
with strong process judgment and team buy-in.
 *  Partner with product and engineering to identify automation opportunities 
in extraction, QA, and model updates.
 *  Work cross-functionally with client success and senior leadership to 
translate client needs into research priorities.


Skills & Qualifications:


 *  10+ years of experience in equity research, financial data delivery, or a 
closely related field, within organizations where research output is the core 
product
 *  At least 2 years managing teams of 20+, with hands-on experience handling 
performance issues, capacity planning, and team development at scale.
 *  Strong grounding in financial statements, earnings analysis, and 
sector-specific modelling, with an understanding of how buy-side and sell-side 
professionals use this data
 *  Proven track record of driving meaningful process improvements, including 
identifying broken workflows, redesigning them, and delivering measurable 
impact.
 *  Experience with automation in research or data workflows, through 
proprietary tools, RPA platforms, or collaboration with engineering teams
 *  Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to present to 
senior stakeholders and articulate research methodology and quality standards 
effectively
 *  MBA/postgraduate qualification from a strong institution or CFA charter 
preferred, but not mandatory for otherwise strong candidates


Good to have:


 *  Background in a high-growth or scaling startup environment, with 
experience building processes rather than inheriting them.
 *  Hands-on experience with platforms such as Bloomberg, AlphaSense, LSEG 
Refinitiv, FactSet, or SCP Capital IQ
 *  Exposure to AI-assisted research tools or structured data tagging workflows
 *  Sector expertise in at least one area within the primary GICS 
classification


Why Join Daloopa?


 *  Impact at scale: Your work directly supports some of the world’s most 
demanding investment teams.
 * Culture of excellence: Be part of a team that values accuracy, speed, and 
raising the bar every day.
 * Growth opportunities: Gain exposure to global capital markets while 
sharpening your financial and analytical skills.
 * Dynamic workplace: A culture built on ownership, transparency, and 
collaboration, where every contribution matters.

About Daloopa, Inc.




The data layer behind how AI actually works in finance. Daloopa turns messy 
financial disclosures into audit-grade, model-ready data used by institutions 
like Morgan Stanley. Its infrastructure sits behind flagship launches such as 
Anthropic's Claude for Financial Services and OpenAI's MCP-based financial 
workflows via Daloopa's official ChatGPT connector, giving AI agents direct 
access to verified, traceable fundamentals.

It doesn't just move data; it makes it usable for LLMs in high-stakes, 
regulated environments where accuracy, sourcing, and auditability actually 
matter. This role in production AI for finance has been recognized by outlets 
like Fast Company 's Most Innovative Companies 2026 list.




The Role:

Daloopa's mission is to become the market leader in high-quality, actionable 
data for the world's top investment professionals. We're judged on three 
things: coverage, speed, and accuracy. Behind those three numbers is a large 
operations team of financial analysts who build, update, and review models for 
thousands of public companies, and we're scaling that coverage toward 10,000 
tickers.




At that scale, the way the operations floor runs becomes a product in its own 
right. Today a lot of that work lives in Excel trackers, Slack threads, and 
manual hand-offs: deciding which companies report when, who picks up which 
model, how reviews get done, and where an analyst goes to find the right 
process. That doesn't scale, and it's where this role comes in.




As a Senior Backend Engineer on Operations Transformation, you'll sit in the 
Engineering organization and partner directly with our Operations and 
Transformation leaders, who own the product requirements. You'll build the 
services behind a new generation of internal products: AI-assisted automation 
of analyst work, workflow systems that replace spreadsheets and Slack 
back-and-forth, and the planning and visibility data team leads and sector 
heads need to run a 10,000-ticker operation. You'll own the backend end to end 
(APIs, data model, background jobs, and LLM pipelines), work with the engineers 
building the interfaces analysts use, and integrate with Daloopa's core content 
platforms, following the same engineering standards as the rest of Engineering.

 

A large part of the role is applied AI. That means getting close to LLMs: 
building pipelines, writing evals, and iterating on prompting strategies and 
model outputs until they are reliable enough for analysts to trust. In a domain 
where the quality of the output moves capital, "it looked right in the demo" 
isn't the bar.

If you like being close to your users, building backend systems people rely 
on every day, and applying AI where it measurably saves time rather than where 
it looks impressive, this is the role.




What Sets You Up for Success:


 * 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience.
 * Strong expertise in Python and Django (or an equivalent backend framework); 
FastAPI experience is a plus.
 * Deep understanding of relational and non-relational databases (MySQL, 
PostgreSQL, Redis), including schema design and query performance under real 
load.
 * Solid experience with distributed systems, caching, and asynchronous task 
queues (Celery or equivalent).
 * Solid understanding of RESTful and/or GraphQL API design.
 * Hands-on experience working with LLMs in production: building pipelines, 
writing evals, iterating on prompts and model outputs, using structured 
outputs, and handling failures, latency, and cost.
 * Comfortable designing for observability, resilience, and graceful 
degradation in systems people depend on hour to hour.
 * Experience building internal tools, workflow systems, or automation that 
replaced manual or spreadsheet-driven processes.
 * Comfortable working directly with non-engineering stakeholders: turning 
loosely defined operational problems into scoped, shippable increments.
 * Track record of owning backend projects end to end with minimal 
hand-holding.


Bonus Points for:


 * Experience with workflow, scheduling, or resource-planning systems 
(assignment, capacity, SLAs, status tracking).
 * Experience building retrieval-augmented (RAG) assistants or knowledge bases 
over internal documentation.
 * Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling (tracing, eval 
datasets, regression testing of prompts).
 * Experience automating Excel/Google Sheets workflows or migrating them into 
proper applications.
 * Background in fintech, financial data, or other domains where data quality 
is mission-critical and audit trails matter.
 * Familiarity with financial fundamentals: 10-Ks, 10-Qs, earnings releases, 
transcripts, segment reporting.
 * Prior experience at growth-stage startups, working in fast-moving teams 
with changing priorities.

Role Overview 

We are seeking a Senior Analyst to review and validate historical financial 
models across sectors including Technology/TMT, BFSI, Consumer, Energy & 
Utilities, and Industrials. The role calls for strong financial modelling 
fundamentals, sound analytical judgment, and the ability to assess company 
disclosures and sector KPIs. Expertise in one or two sectors is welcome; 
candidates should be willing to work across industries. You will also use 
emerging Generative AI and large language model (LLM) tools to improve review 
quality and efficiency.




Key Responsibilities 


 *  Review new and quarterly updated financial models for numerical accuracy, 
logical consistency, completeness, and adherence to QA standards.
 *  Validate financial statements, formulas, supporting schedules, and source 
documents, including annual reports, quarterly filings, earnings releases, and 
investor presentations.
 *  Investigate complex accounting or modelling issues, document findings, and 
provide clear, evidence-based feedback to analysts and reviewers.
 *  Identify recurring errors, maintain QA trackers and error logs, and 
recommend practical process improvements.
 *  Use AI-assisted review tools while independently validating their findings 
and escalating unreliable results.
 * Mentor junior analysts, share review best practices, and take ownership of 
timely, highquality deliverables


Skills & Qualifications 


 *  Strong knowledge of financial statements, accounting principles, financial 
modelling, and advanced Excel.
 *  Understanding of company reporting patterns, financial disclosures, and 
sector-specific KPIs; expertise in one or more industries is an advantage.
 *  Experience with financial research, equity research, investment banking, 
financial data, or related analytical workflows.
 *  Practical familiarity with GenAI/LLM tools, including basic understanding 
of algorithms, how AI generated outputs are produced, and their limitations; 
ability to evaluate outputs critically.
 *  Excellent attention to detail, analytical judgment, communication, 
ownership, and ability to guide junior colleagues


Education & Experience 


 *  Bachelor's degree from a Tier 1 institution or MBA / CA / CFA Level I or 
above. 
 * 2-4 years of experience in financial research, modelling, or analytical 
roles; exposure to one or more sectors across US, Europe, APAC, or LATAM


Why Join Daloopa? 


 * Impact at scale: Your work directly supports some of the world’s most 
demanding investment teams.
 *  Culture of excellence: Be part of a team that values accuracy, speed, and 
raising the bar every day.
 *  Growth opportunities: Gain exposure to global capital markets while 
sharpening your financial and analytical skills.
 *  Dynamic workplace: A culture built on ownership, transparency, and 
collaboration, where every contribution matters.   


Employee Benefits 


 *  Comprehensive Health Insurance 
 *  Employee well-being program with 24x7 medical assistance 
 *  Work-life balance with flexible policies

reqDetailsBOList.reqTitle: Senior Product Manager - Human In Loop Experiences
reqDetailsBOList.jdDisplay:
Location: India (Remote) 

Department: Product




About Daloopa: 

Daloopa is the leading provider of AI-powered fundamental data for 
institutional investors. Headquartered in New York, with a growing team in 
India, Daloopa's proprietary platform sources, structures, and distributes one 
of the most comprehensive and accurate financial datasets in the market, 
helping investors accelerate research, financial modeling, and decision-making.

Trusted by hedge funds, private equity firms, mutual funds, corporates, and 
investment banks globally, Daloopa recently secured $47 million in Series C 
funding, bringing total funding to over $100 million. This investment will 
accelerate the company's mission of powering the next generation of AI-driven 
financial workflows.

At Daloopa, we are driven by our values: Obsess over the Customer, Raise the 
Bar, Be Intensely Proactive, and No BS. Joining us means being part of a 
high-performance culture where innovation, ownership, and impact go hand in 
hand.




Role Overview: 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the platform where humans 
and AI work together on live financial data — the review and feedback layer 
that supplements our AI extraction systems.

Every correction, override, and judgment call a human analyst makes in this 
product is a signal. Your job is to design the experience so that signal gets 
captured cleanly and routed back into the systems that need it: better context 
for the model at the point of decision, structured feedback loops, and inputs 
that improve accuracy of our data. As coverage expands into new regions, 
document types, and event types, this layer is what keeps quality improving 
across this expanding perimeter.

You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, and Product leadership to 
design review workflows that are fast for the analyst and help tune AI, and to 
build the instrumentation that turns human review into a compounding asset.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who is deeply technical, highly 
execution-oriented, and excited about building the human-AI interface for a 
real-world AI system at scale.




Key Responsibilities:


 * Own the roadmap for the review and feedback experience, covering how 
analysts see model context, make corrections, and resolve disagreements between 
AI output and ground truth.
 * Design context management into the workflow — surfacing the right source 
documents, prior decisions, and model reasoning at the moment an analyst needs 
to judge or correct an output, so review speed doesn't trade off against review 
quality.
 * Build the feedback and tuning loop end to end: capture structured signal 
from every human correction, route it to the AI/ML team in a form they can act 
on, and close the loop by measuring whether it changed downstream accuracy.
 * Partner with Engineering and AI/ML to define what needs to be reviewed, 
what the ideal review experience is, and how it endures with future AI model 
updates.
 * Instrument the full workflow from document to reviewed datapoint, with a 
single metric the team can rally around for review speed and error rate.
 * Collaborate cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, and Operations 
to align priorities, execute quickly, and deliver measurable business impact.
 * Stay current on advancements in AI/LLMs and apply emerging capabilities — 
particularly around human-in-the-loop tuning and RLHF-style feedback — 
thoughtfully into platform strategy and execution.


Skills and Qualifications 

We're looking for a highly technical Product Manager with 3+ years of 
experience building AI/ML product features, or workflow/tooling products, and 
8+ years of PM experience at Series B or later companies.

You'll be a strong fit if you:


 * Have experience owning complex platform or workflow products end-to-end, 
ideally ones where humans review or correct AI/ML output.
 * Have worked closely with AI/ML systems, LLM workflows, or human-in-the-loop 
annotation and review tooling.
 * Understand the mechanics of feedback loops: how to capture a human 
correction as structured signal, and how that signal should reach a model or 
tuning pipeline.
 * Can design for two audiences at once — the analyst doing the review and the 
AI/ML system consuming what the review produces — without over-indexing on 
either.
 * Can comfortably work with highly technical teams and participate in 
architecture and system design discussions.
 * Have strong product judgment and can balance review speed, data quality, 
and operational complexity.
 * Are highly analytical and comfortable balancing use of data and 
domain-specific intuition to drive prioritization and decision-making.
 * Have experience designing experimentation frameworks, benchmark 
evaluations, or feedback loop systems.
 * Possess strong written and verbal communication skills and can simplify 
complex technical concepts.
 * Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with high ownership and 
autonomy.


Preferred Qualifications


 * Have shipped, as an IC, at least 1 AI-native product or agentic workflow or 
hybrid ML/LLM system into production at 1K+ DAU or transactions per day scale.
 * Shipped at least 1 human-in-loop review, annotation, or QA tooling product 
feature to at least 1K+ DAU.
 * Familiarity with SQL, experimentation frameworks, and product analytics 
tools.
 * Experience scaling review or QA workflows across multiple workflows, 
geographies, or datasets.
 * Background in B2B SaaS, AI infrastructure, or FinTech products.


Why Join Daloopa?

Impact at scale: Your work directly supports some of the world’s most 
demanding investment teams.

Culture of excellence: Be part of a team that values accuracy, speed, and 
raising the bar every day.

Growth opportunities: Gain exposure to global capital markets while 
sharpening your financial and analytical skills.

Dynamic workplace: A culture built on ownership, transparency, and 
collaboration, where every contribution matters.




Employee Benefits


 * Comprehensive Health Insurance
 * Employee well-being program with 24x7 medical assistance
 * Work-life balance with flexible policies

transforming complex financial data into actionable intelligence through

Daloopa's data acquisition engine and plays a fundamental role in our ability 
to fuel the next generation of financial intelligence.

listRow.reqTitle: Senior Product Manager - Human In Loop Experiences
listRow.jdDisplay:
Location: India (Remote) 

Department: Product




About Daloopa: 

Daloopa is the leading provider of AI-powered fundamental data for 
institutional investors. Headquartered in New York, with a growing team in 
India, Daloopa's proprietary platform sources, structures, and distributes one 
of the most comprehensive and accurate financial datasets in the market, 
helping investors accelerate research, financial modeling, and decision-making.

Trusted by hedge funds, private equity firms, mutual funds, corporates, and 
investment banks globally, Daloopa recently secured $47 million in Series C 
funding, bringing total funding to over $100 million. This investment will 
accelerate the company's mission of powering the next generation of AI-driven 
financial workflows.

At Daloopa, we are driven by our values: Obsess over the Customer, Raise the 
Bar, Be Intensely Proactive, and No BS. Joining us means being part of a 
high-performance culture where innovation, ownership, and impact go hand in 
hand.




Role Overview: 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the platform where humans 
and AI work together on live financial data — the review and feedback layer 
that supplements our AI extraction systems.

Every correction, override, and judgment call a human analyst makes in this 
product is a signal. Your job is to design the experience so that signal gets 
captured cleanly and routed back into the systems that need it: better context 
for the model at the point of decision, structured feedback loops, and inputs 
that improve accuracy of our data. As coverage expands into new regions, 
document types, and event types, this layer is what keeps quality improving 
across this expanding perimeter.

You will work closely with Engineering, Operations, and Product leadership to 
design review workflows that are fast for the analyst and help tune AI, and to 
build the instrumentation that turns human review into a compounding asset.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who is deeply technical, highly 
execution-oriented, and excited about building the human-AI interface for a 
real-world AI system at scale.




Key Responsibilities:


 * Own the roadmap for the review and feedback experience, covering how 
analysts see model context, make corrections, and resolve disagreements between 
AI output and ground truth.
 * Design context management into the workflow — surfacing the right source 
documents, prior decisions, and model reasoning at the moment an analyst needs 
to judge or correct an output, so review speed doesn't trade off against review 
quality.
 * Build the feedback and tuning loop end to end: capture structured signal 
from every human correction, route it to the AI/ML team in a form they can act 
on, and close the loop by measuring whether it changed downstream accuracy.
 * Partner with Engineering and AI/ML to define what needs to be reviewed, 
what the ideal review experience is, and how it endures with future AI model 
updates.
 * Instrument the full workflow from document to reviewed datapoint, with a 
single metric the team can rally around for review speed and error rate.
 * Collaborate cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, and Operations 
to align priorities, execute quickly, and deliver measurable business impact.
 * Stay current on advancements in AI/LLMs and apply emerging capabilities — 
particularly around human-in-the-loop tuning and RLHF-style feedback — 
thoughtfully into platform strategy and execution.


Skills and Qualifications 

We're looking for a highly technical Product Manager with 3+ years of 
experience building AI/ML product features, or workflow/tooling products, and 
8+ years of PM experience at Series B or later companies.

You'll be a strong fit if you:


 * Have experience owning complex platform or workflow products end-to-end, 
ideally ones where humans review or correct AI/ML output.
 * Have worked closely with AI/ML systems, LLM workflows, or human-in-the-loop 
annotation and review tooling.
 * Understand the mechanics of feedback loops: how to capture a human 
correction as structured signal, and how that signal should reach a model or 
tuning pipeline.
 * Can design for two audiences at once — the analyst doing the review and the 
AI/ML system consuming what the review produces — without over-indexing on 
either.
 * Can comfortably work with highly technical teams and participate in 
architecture and system design discussions.
 * Have strong product judgment and can balance review speed, data quality, 
and operational complexity.
 * Are highly analytical and comfortable balancing use of data and 
domain-specific intuition to drive prioritization and decision-making.
 * Have experience designing experimentation frameworks, benchmark 
evaluations, or feedback loop systems.
 * Possess strong written and verbal communication skills and can simplify 
complex technical concepts.
 * Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with high ownership and 
autonomy.


Preferred Qualifications


 * Have shipped, as an IC, at least 1 AI-native product or agentic workflow or 
hybrid ML/LLM system into production at 1K+ DAU or transactions per day scale.
 * Shipped at least 1 human-in-loop review, annotation, or QA tooling product 
feature to at least 1K+ DAU.
 * Familiarity with SQL, experimentation frameworks, and product analytics 
tools.
 * Experience scaling review or QA workflows across multiple workflows, 
geographies, or datasets.
 * Background in B2B SaaS, AI infrastructure, or FinTech products.


Why Join Daloopa?

Impact at scale: Your work directly supports some of the world’s most 
demanding investment teams.

Culture of excellence: Be part of a team that values accuracy, speed, and 
raising the bar every day.

Growth opportunities: Gain exposure to global capital markets while 
sharpening your financial and analytical skills.

Dynamic workplace: A culture built on ownership, transparency, and 
collaboration, where every contribution matters.




Employee Benefits


 * Comprehensive Health Insurance
 * Employee well-being program with 24x7 medical assistance
 * Work-life balance with flexible policies
